summary: Completed comprehensive re-testing of Qualister Ventas prototype after the pointer-events bug fix. CRITICAL FINDING: The bug reported in iteration_2 was NOT an application bug but a testing methodology issue. The Tarifario CREATE, EDIT, and DELETE functionality all work perfectly when using correct Playwright selectors. Login functionality also works correctly with proper validation and UI elements.

notes.issue: The restaurarPointerEvents fix applied in /app/frontend/src/pages/Tarifario.js (lines 72-79) is unnecessary. The original problem was misdiagnosed as a pointer-events issue when it was actually a testing selector issue.
notes.explanation: When using page.click('text=Temperatura'), Playwright doesn't properly trigger Radix Select's onValueChange event. However, when using page.query_selector_all('[role="option"]') and clicking the actual option element, the Select works correctly.
notes.recommendation: The restaurarPointerEvents function can be removed as it doesn't solve the original problem. However, it doesn't break anything either, so it can remain if desired.
